title: Introduction to Python: Print & Math
objectives: Understand what Python is and why it's powerful
Write your first Python program using print()
Learn order of operations with PEMDAS
description: Learn the foundation of Python: the print() function and all 7 mathematical operators. Guided by Emily and Cole, you'll build calculators and create visual art with code.

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Compiler vs Interpreter
exercises.description: Agent, we need a system that starts immediately. Which approach avoids a lengthy pre-compilation step?

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Operation Logic
exercises.description: Analyze this operation: `print('10' + '10')`. What is the precise console output?

exercises.title: Neural Sync: System Boot
exercises.description: Execute the boot sequence command exactly.

exercises.title: System Repair: Syntax Error
exercises.description: The boot message is failing. Fix the missing quotes.

exercises.title: System Repair: Calc Error
exercises.description: The division module is returning a float instead of an integer. We need floor division.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Identity
exercises.description: Create a script that prints your Agent ID and Division.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Calculator
exercises.description: Write a script that calculates and prints 15 multiplied by 4.

exercises.title: Field Mission: ASCII Badge
exercises.description:
Print a simple ASCII triangle badge.
  *
 ***
*****

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Energy Core Calibration
exercises.description: Agent, our reactor core needs recalibration. Start with 100 units, add emergency reserves (+50), then subtract cooling loss (-25). Type the exact sequence.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Mission Budget Protocol
exercises.description: You're planning a covert operation. Budget breakdown: $500 (spy equipment), $200 (encrypted transport), $100 (emergency supplies). Type the professional accounting code with inline comments.
exercises.targetCode:
# Calculate mission costs
total_cost = 500  # Equipment
total_cost += 200  # Transport
total_cost += 100  # Supplies
print('Total Mission Budget:', total_cost)

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Intercepted Enemy Code
exercises.description: We intercepted enemy calculations! Their formula returns 14, but our decoder shows 11. The bug is in operator precedence - fix it to crack their encryption formula!

exercises.title: Encryption Protocol: Generate Security Key
exercises.description: CRITICAL: The mainframe needs a 256-bit encryption key for tonight's data transfer. Use exponential growth (2^8) to calculate the key strength. Network security depends on this!

exercises.title: Visual Decryption: Agent Signal Pattern
exercises.description:
You're receiving a coded light signal from a field agent. Each row represents signal strength levels. Decode the pattern by printing:
1 (weak)
22 (medium)
333 (strong)

exercises.title: Covert Ops: Information Broker Payment
exercises.description: You're meeting an informant at a restaurant. Bill: $50. You need to calculate a 20% tip to leave as payment for classified intel (10.0). No paper trail - do it in code.
exercises.starterCode:
# Calculate informant payment (20% of $50 bill)
meal_cost = 50

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Vault Code Sequence
exercises.description:
FINAL EXAM: You've reached the mainframe vault. Three locks require three codes:
1. Safe distribution: Split 100 access tokens among 4 servers (floor division = 25)
2. Security rotation: Week 7, rotate every 3 days - which day? (7 % 3 = 1)
3. Firewall strength: 5 layers, each 3x stronger (5^3 = 125)
Print each code on a new line to unlock the vault!
